rationale: relates_to entries are unnormalized free text with no case-normalization upstream; sprint.py already establishes case-insensitive EPIC-id-shape detection via _EPIC_ID_RE (sprint.py:14,319,322), so reusing it avoids a case-sensitivity regression that a plain startswith check would leave open
rule: Filter forward_ids via _EPIC_ID_RE.match() (case-insensitive), not a literal .startswith("EPIC-") check
alternatives_rejected: Option A: {i for i in epic_info.relates_to if not i.startswith("EPIC-")} — mirrors BUG-2638's next_issues.py pattern but is case-sensitive and would miss a lowercase/mixed-case sibling-EPIC relates_to entry
